carrier_definition.base: cyclotomic Z_p-extension Q_infty/Q, with p an odd prime
carrier_definition.Lambda: Z_p[[Gamma]] is isomorphic to Z_p[[T]], with T = gamma - 1 for a topological generator gamma
carrier_definition.type: Noetherian p-adic module-theoretic carrier, not a complex Hilbert carrier
carrier_definition.native_context: height-one prime and characteristic-ideal ledger in the Iwasawa algebra

iwasawa_module.layers: Q_n in Q_infty, equivalently cyclotomic layers inside Q(mu_{p^{n+1}}) after fixing the standard component
iwasawa_module.A_n: p-primary class-group component in the n-th cyclotomic layer, with character components when chi is fixed
iwasawa_module.X_infty: inverse limit of A_n under norm maps
iwasawa_module.module_status: finitely generated torsion Lambda_chi module in the classical cyclotomic main-conjecture setting
iwasawa_module.operator: Gamma acts continuously on X_infty; T = gamma - 1 is the Lambda coordinate

p_adic_L_function.name: Kubota-Leopoldt p-adic L-function L_p(chi)
p_adic_L_function.element: L_p(chi) in Lambda_chi, determined up to Lambda_chi unit
p_adic_L_function.interpolation: interpolates special Dirichlet L-values in the p-adic variable
p_adic_L_function.caveat: interpolation is a p-adic special-value ledger and does not imply the complex zero-line statement for Riemann zeta

characteristic_ideal.zero_structure: height-one prime valuations and Lambda divisors of the torsion module

parent_residual_on_IW.name: Xi_IW
parent_residual_on_IW.zero_condition: Xi_IW^chi = 0 iff the characteristic ideal equals the p-adic L-function ideal up to unit
parent_residual_on_IW.native_probe_side: finite-order characters of Gamma, height-one primes, class-group norm-compatible components
parent_residual_on_IW.dissolving_probe_side: p-adic L-values and Kubota-Leopoldt interpolation data

CRE_status_reason: Closing Xi_IW proves the Iwasawa main conjecture in the chosen p-adic setting; it does not imply Riemann's complex RH and is not logically equivalent to it.
CRCFT_applicability_reason: CRCFT is the foreclosure taxonomy for classically-RH-equivalent carriers.  This carrier is non-CRE and has a proved native module-theoretic ledger.

framework_closure_status.Xi_IW: 0 by Mazur-Wiles for the cyclotomic carrier over Q, componentwise in the classical scope
framework_closure_status.native_ledger: Lambda characteristic ideal ledger plus Kubota-Leopoldt p-adic L-function
framework_closure_status.extensions: Wiles 1990 extends the main conjecture to totally real fields; Skinner-Urban 2014 supplies GL2 main-conjecture results under stated ordinary/hypothesis scopes

classical_theorems_cited.use: cyclotomic tower, Iwasawa modules, Lambda-adic class-group structure
construction of p-adic L-functions for Dirichlet characters

classical_theorems_cited.source: Mazur-Wiles 1984, Class fields of abelian extensions of Q
classical_theorems_cited.use: proof of the cyclotomic Iwasawa main conjecture over Q

classical_theorems_cited.source: Wiles 1990, The Iwasawa conjecture for totally real fields
classical_theorems_cited.use: totally real extension of the main conjecture

classical_theorems_cited.source: Skinner-Urban 2014, The Iwasawa Main Conjectures for GL2
classical_theorems_cited.use: GL2 p-adic main-conjecture extension under stated hypotheses
